design.research_question: Does the already released P4-O stack preserve a cross-language explicit correction as one auditable lifecycle across a true Python-process restart, without adding product code?
design.single_variable: one new Chinese-old to Japanese-new explicit correction pair in a fresh temporary Persistent Chroma database
design.success: old positive remains historical, linked explicit negative remains present, Japanese correction is the unique active record, all three records remain byte-canonically unchanged across restart and answer-absent English recall returns only the new Japanese value
design.failure: any missing or rewritten lineage record, non-unique active state, process-identity reuse, mutation during recall, old-value answer use, abstention or wrong visible surface

result_policy.implementation_if_pass: none; release the evidence and separately freeze a future Safari delivery case
result_policy.implementation_if_fail: none in the result commit; localize one mechanism gap before a separately frozen change

claim_boundary: This freeze authorizes exactly one offline two-process correction-lifecycle diagnostic with new development values. It does not authorize Safari execution, product implementation, retuning, a retry, arbitrary multilingual correction, long-dialogue memory, felt understanding, LLM superiority or a human equation.
